## Summary
Extends the isolated visual-preview architecture to Plan & Billing, matching the approved Claude Design export (\MindMosaic — Plan & billing.html\, artboards 01–07).

### Implemented Screens & Artboards
- **Family Active (01)**: Subscription dashboard with active Family plan (.90/mo), renewal date (28 Nov 2026), 2 of 3 paid places used, feature inclusions checklist, Visa ending in 4242 payment card, and past invoices table.
- **Mobile Active (02)**: Compact 390px mobile view with stacked summary cards.
- **Payment Failed (03)**: Warning state highlighting declined charge on 28 Oct 2026, grace period active until 4 Nov 2026, with retry payment and update card actions.
- **Cancellation Scheduled (04)**: Retention alert confirming cancellation on 28 Nov 2026, student access preserved through end of paid period, and resume subscription action.
- **Free Account & Upgrade (05)**: Free tier with sample practice questions vs Family Plan comparison, billing cycle toggle (monthly .90 vs annual  with 17% savings).
- **Loading, Empty & Error States (06)**: Skeleton loader, empty invoice history state, and network retry state.
- **Mobile Failed & Cancelling (07)**: Mobile variations of error and cancellation states.

### Preview Gate & Isolation
- **Gate**: \BILLING_PREVIEW=1\, loopback host only (\localhost\, \127.0.0.1\), \!isSupabaseConfigured\, not on Vercel.
- **Zero Real Writes**: Checkout, payment method update, cancellation, and receipt download execute in local React state only. No Stripe API requests or customer charges occurred.
- **Outside Preview**: Standard Stripe webhook listeners, customer portal redirect, and live subscriptions hold completely unchanged.

### Verification Passed
- \
pm run typecheck\: Passed (0 errors)
- Vitest \src/tests/pages/billing-preview-mode.test.tsx\: Passed (10 tests)
- \
px next build --webpack\: Passed cleanly (compiled all 69 static & dynamic routes)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
